name: Moosend
description: Moosend is an email marketing platform for mailing lists, subscribers, campaigns, automation, segments, forms, and reporting.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Moosend account with an encrypted customer-generated account API key. Relay contains the broad key with one selected mailing list, non-email subscriber ID, and campaign ID, exposes only subscriber timestamps and non-statistical campaign lifecycle metadata, and blocks private data, content, senders, statistics, broad access, exports, and mutations.

credentialRequirements.name: MOOSEND_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Moosend API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: A customer-generated account API key; Relay encrypts it and sends it only to the fixed api.moosend.com request.

credentialRequirements.name: MOOSEND_MAILING_LIST_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Selected mailing list ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact list containing the selected subscriber.

credentialRequirements.name: MOOSEND_SUBSCRIBER_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Selected subscriber ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact non-email subscriber ID whose ID and timestamps Relay may read.

credentialRequirements.name: MOOSEND_CAMPAIGN_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Selected campaign ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact campaign whose bounded non-statistical details Relay may read.

capabilities.label: Read selected subscriber summary
capabilities.description: Read only the ID and timestamps for one selected subscriber without identity, email, status, preferences, custom fields, tags, IP, or activity.

capabilities.label: Read selected campaign summary
capabilities.description: Read bounded lifecycle metadata for one selected campaign without message content, sender data, recipients, lists, or statistics.

allowed.label: Read selected subscriber summary
allowed.description: Read the selected subscriber's ID and timestamps while discarding all personal, preference, and engagement fields.

allowed.label: Read selected campaign summary
allowed.description: Read the selected campaign's ID, status, transactional flag, and timestamps using the non-statistical details endpoint.

blocked.label: Expose private marketing data
blocked.description: Subscriber identity, email, status, preferences, custom fields, tags, IP, and activity plus campaign name, subject, content, sender, recipients, lists, links, and statistics are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate Moosend state
blocked.description: Subscribers, lists, segments, campaigns, sends, automation, webhooks, and every other mutation are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broad Moosend access
blocked.description: Other subscribers, lists, campaigns, segments, reports, arbitrary paths or queries, redirects, downloads, and exports are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Read Only
approvalProfiles.description: Read one selected subscriber and campaign through an encrypted account API key; private data, broader access, statistics, and mutations remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway stores the encrypted customer API key server-side and mounts exactly two selected-resource projected reads.
Railway stores the encrypted customer API key server-side and mounts exactly two selected-resource projected reads.

providerSetup.blocker: A Moosend staging account, newly generated account API key, mailing-list ID, non-email subscriber ID, and campaign ID are required. No authorized account or credentials are available in this worker lane.
providerSetup.nextAction: The provider-console lane must generate a new staging API key, capture it directly in Railway, bind exact resource IDs, then validate both redacted reads, query-key containment, non-statistical campaign selection, authorization and rate errors, key replacement, regeneration revocation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial in Fairfax.

evidence.supports: Moosend documents one unique account API key, required as the apikey query parameter for every request, and regeneration as the replacement path.

Moosend documents GET /v3/subscribers/{MailingListID}/find/{SubscriberID}.json and the identity, email, status, preferences, tags, custom fields, and timestamps returned; Relay exposes only ID and timestamps.
Moosend documents GET /v3/campaigns/{CampaignID}/view.json as the selected campaign details endpoint without statistics and lists the message, sender, and audience details Relay excludes.
Moosend documents that the separate view-summary endpoint returns recipient, open, click, bounce, complaint, forward, unsubscribe, and send statistics; Relay does not call it.
